logger.doc:name: Log Sync Trigger
logger.message: [MuleSoft LSC] Triggering PostgreSQL Hospital Patient Labs Sync to Salesforce muthulifescience org...

db:select.doc:name: Select NEW Hospital Labs from PostgreSQL

logger.doc:name: Log Query Results
logger.message: #['[MuleSoft LSC] Found ' ++ sizeOf(payload) ++ ' new patient lab records in PostgreSQL']

ee:transform.doc:name: DataWeave 2.0: SQL Rows to Salesforce CareObservation

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- payload map ( labRow ) -> { "Name": "FHIR R4 Observation: " ++ (labRow.test_code default "Biomarker Telemetry"), "ObservedSubjectId": labRow.patient_external_id, "NumericValue": labRow.numeric_value as Number, "ObservedValueText": (labRow.numeric_value as String) ++ " " ++ (labRow.unit_of_measure default "ng/mL"), "ObservationStatus": if (upper(labRow.result_status) == "FINAL") "Final" else "Preliminary", "Category": "Laboratory", "SourceSystem": "Epic EHR - MuleSoft Direct PostgreSQL Pipeline", "SourceSystemIdentifier": labRow.lab_id }

db:update.doc:name: Update PostgreSQL sync_status

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "SUCCESS", "message": "Successfully synchronized patient lab data from PostgreSQL to Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud (muthulifescience)", "recordsProcessed": sizeOf(vars.postgresLabs), "salesforceResult": payload }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "NO_DATA", "message": "No new patient lab records found in PostgreSQL (sync_status = 'NEW')" }

logger.doc:name: Log Inbound FHIR Payload
logger.message: #['[MuleSoft FHIR Gateway] Inbound HL7 FHIR R4 Observation Payload received: ' ++ write(payload, 'application/json')]

ee:transform.doc:name: DataWeave 2.0: FHIR R4 JSON to Salesforce CareObservation

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- [{ "Name": "FHIR R4 Observation: " ++ (payload.code.text default "Biomarker Telemetry"), "ObservedSubjectId": (payload.subject.reference replace "Patient/" with ""), "NumericValue": payload.valueQuantity.value as Number, "ObservedValueText": (payload.valueQuantity.value as String) ++ " " ++ (payload.valueQuantity.unit default "ng/mL"), "ObservationStatus": if (lower(payload.status) == "final") "Final" else "Preliminary", "Category": if (payload.category[0].coding[0].code == "vital-signs") "Vital Signs" else "Laboratory", "SourceSystem": "Epic EHR - MuleSoft Direct Gateway", "SourceSystemIdentifier": payload.id }]
